About this item

  • Womens Backpack Style Meets Functionality: Quilted backpack for women elevates your look while keeping you organized. Our chic lightweight backpack seamlessly integrates contemporary design with everyday functionality. Whether for work, college, or leisure, it serves as an essential accessory
  • Organized Everyday Storage:This women’s backpack is designed to keep your daily essentials neatly arranged. The main compartment for 1-3 lightweight travel outfits,3 A4 notebooks. A padded laptop sleeve fits slim laptops up to 13-15.6 inches.Three quick-access exterior compartments and two side pockets can conveniently store items like a narrower water bottle. Dimensions: 17.3 × 11.8 × 7.9 inches.
  • Comfort Redefined: Enjoy enhanced comfort with padded, adjustable shoulder straps that evenly distribute weight. The laptop backpack for women with breathable mesh back panel offers excellent ergonomic support while keeping you cool during extended wear, whether you're heading out for the day or carrying your travel, work or college essentials. Embrace every moment with ease and style
  • Versatile Travel Backpack: This women’s work backpack is more than just a bookbag—it's a travel companion! With its TSA-friendly design and luggage strap, this cute backpack easily slides over suitcase handles, making it perfect for everything from weekend getaways to daily commutes. Whether you’re exploring the great outdoors or navigating your daily routine, this backpack has got your back
  • Built to Last: Puffer backpack crafted from durable, water-resistant puffy fabric, the BAGSMART Laptop Backpack is designed to withstand everyday use. With protective padded foam to shield your laptop from bumps and shocks, plus a robust zipper for smooth operation, this small backpack for women promises longevity and reliability throughout your adventures

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers find this backpack to be of good quality, spacious, and well-suited for travel, with one customer noting it can be used as a personal item on flights. They appreciate its pockets, particularly the trolley sleeve and interior organization, and its capacity to fit multiple books and a laptop in the main pocket. Customers consider it worth the price and functional for carry-on use. The zipper quality receives mixed reviews, with some customers finding them strong while others report them breaking after a few weeks of use.

  • M. C. Starbuck
    5 out of 5 stars
    Exactly what I wanted!
    Reviewed in the United States on November 7, 2022
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Pros:

    -The size! The measurements allow it to be a personal item on flights, but it's on the large end of their requirements. This allows me to keep more stuff with me on my flight, which makes me feel better if something happens to my checked bag. But it's also not so big that I look more like a little kid than I already do (I'm 5ft3in).

    -I love all the different fabrics. Soft and durable.

    -Holds my laptop (14.5in?) in its case, cord, mouse plus my camera with 2 lenses! I wanted all my electronics and liquids to be in the same bag so when I need to take them out at security, I don't have to go back and forth between my personal item and my carry-on.

    -The color! I was nervous since they call it baby pink. I thought it might be too childish looking. But it's actually more in the mauve pink or rose gold family like I was hoping. So it even coordinates with lots of my favorite items. I also love that EVERYTHING is the same color...zippers, mesh, stitching, all the fabric, straps, inside and out, even their logo. I love that it makes it look less busy. It's just calming to have it all the same color. It's so silly, but I get annoyed when people make a good product with a bad design. Whoever designed this is amazing and great at their job...or at least good at designing things I like, ha!

    -Easy access to pockets! I love having double zippers on big pockets and not having that flap over the zipper. I think it's to deter others from unzipping it? But it just gets in my way. So I'm glad that's not on the small pocket. I guess it's kind of over one of the bigger pouches, but that doesn't get in the way as much, and I don't usually want access to that pocket as frequently as a small front pocket.

    -2 ways to carry it hands-free: backpack straps or the strap over a carry-on suitcase.

    -Inexpensive! At least when I purchased it, it was only $20. Definitely worth that even though I already have a backpack I love (but my other backpack doesn't fit my laptop). I think I finally decided on this one because I already have a large camera gear backpack from Bagsmart, so I at least had a little trust in the company. I actually like this backpack even more than the other one I bought from them! I'm so impressed.

    Cons:

    -I don't particularly love the big teeth of 2 of the zippers, but they are the same color as the bag, so they don't stand out or bother me that much.

    -The straps and mesh underneath aren't the most comfortable, but I only plan to wear it around a few airports and maybe a couple of day trips. It's not like I'm trying to use it for backpacking.

    -Water bottle holder doesn't stretch. Don't think it would fit a large water bottle like for backpacking, but I have a slim one that will work. It's just good to know in advance!

    ...

    Overall, I LOVE it and am so happy with it and glad I purchased it even though I was looking into a different one that was more expensive. Can't wait to use it!

    Oh, and I checked the back inside pocket because some people in reviews found a hole in theirs from a bad batch. Mine was perfectly in tact!

    Great Travel Backpack, One Small Con
    Reviewed in the United States on August 22, 2026
    Size: 15.6 InchColor: 04-camel

    This is a great backpack for travel or work, and I definitely recommend it. Bagsmart knows their stuff! I bought this backpack to use specifically for when I travel because I found travel totes to be annoying—it’s so much easier to carry a backpack. This particular one has a medium capacity, it’s smaller than a typical school/college/work backpack, but bigger than a mini backpack. It had more than enough space for my travel pillow and sweatshirt in the main compartment, snacks and charging equipment in the secondary pocket, and small miscellaneous items in the front pocket. It also has a front slip pocket that’s perfect for things like keys, boarding, passes, lip balm. Overall, this bag is great. I loved that I could organize my travel necessities. My ONE qualm, and why I docked a star, is the fact that it only has one zipper pull on each of the main compartments. I know this is minor but it annoyed me enough to mention! I like being able to position the zipper opening where I prefer, and if I (or anyone) needed to lock the zippers together for travel security/anti-theft, it wouldn’t be possible. Overall a great bag.
